name: Downtime — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Downtime from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Downtime" but are not part of the Downtime entry, which is unchanged.

Skilled Capital Earnings

Note that doing skilled work to earn capital gives you the opportunity to purchase that capital, rather than earning the capital outright. To gain capital entirely through skilled work, you will need to first use skilled work to earn gp, then do skilled work again to get a chance to buy capital. /p>

For example, on Day 1 you could work to earn gold. With a check result of 20, you earn 2gp. Labor costs 10gp when you earn it (the Earned Cost), so you’ll have to work for several days to gain enough gold to pay for 1 unit of Labor.
